heading.en: A list that cannot be changed

hook.en: Your date of birth or the GPS location of your college never changes. For such fixed data, Python offers the tuple.

narration.en: Your date of birth or the GPS location of your college never changes. For such fixed data, Python offers the tuple.

body.en: A tuple is an ordered sequence of elements of any type, separated by commas and usually enclosed in parentheses. A tuple with one element needs a trailing comma, like (5,). Elements are accessed by index just like lists and strings. Tuples are immutable: elements cannot be changed after creation.
body.kn: ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಅಲ್ಪವಿರಾಮದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಆವರಣದೊಳಗೆ ಬರೆದ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧ ಸರಣಿ. ಒಂದೇ ಅಂಶದ ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್‌ಗೆ (5,) ಎಂದು ಅಲ್ಪವಿರಾಮ ಬೇಕು. ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗದ್ದು.

title.en: On the board: A tuple is a list that cannot change

say.en: A tuple holds elements in order, inside round brackets. We index it just like a list.
But a tuple is immutable. t of 1 equals 99 raises a TypeError.
For one element we need a comma. Brackets alone just give the number 5.
Plus, star and slicing work like lists, but each gives a NEW tuple. t itself is unchanged.

narration.en: We draw a tuple in memory, see the comma rule for one element, and see that operations make new tuples.

title.en: What does each tuple operation give?

prompt.en: t = (10, 20, 30). Sort each expression by its result.

label.en: A value that is not a tuple

explanation.en: +, * and slicing build new tuples. Indexing gives one element, in gives True/False, and (5) is just the int 5: a one-element tuple needs a comma. Assigning to an element fails because tuples are immutable, a tuple cannot be joined to a list, and index 3 is out of range.
explanation.kn: +, *, ಸ್ಲೈಸ್ ಹೊಸ ಟಪಲ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ. (5) ಕೇವಲ int; (5,) ಟಪಲ್. ಟಪಲ್ ಬದಲಾಗದ ಕಾರಣ t[0] = 5 ದೋಷ.

body.en: Tuples support concatenation (+), repetition (*), membership (in, not in) and slicing, exactly like lists. Each of these returns a new tuple; the original tuple is unchanged.
body.kn: ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್‌ಗಳಿಗೂ ಜೋಡಣೆ (+), ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ (*), ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ (in) ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಲೈಸಿಂಗ್ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಹೊಸ ಟ್ಯೂಪಲ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
